# Security policy

FlowNG is research software, not for clinical diagnostic use. The security model (know your sender) and how to check a
shared file are described in [`doc/SECURITY.md`](../doc/SECURITY.md); the official Check page is
https://davidpng.github.io/FlowNg/check/.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use **private vulnerability reporting**: on the repository's Security tab, choose "Report a vulnerability". Do not
open a public issue, and do not attach patient data or real shared files.

## Supported versions

During the beta only the current release on `main` is supported.
